set.body:
User review actual 9 and mockup brush critique. Reuse current stable pane and typed selection. Add a layout-only recall viewport with whole-domain overview; brush changes the actual main x-domain and labels, independently of scientific focus/horizons. Provide keyboard range, Reveal selected and Reset. Acceptance: demonstrate 4:00–10:00 overview selection with the detail axis exactly 4:00–10:00; no off-window point clamped to an edge; selected identity survives pan/resize/reset; source coordinates remain unchanged. At 390px stack controls/inspector, use a readable detail window, and collapse Key initially. Pointer brushing and keyboard controls must agree. Include untimed inventory without fabricating seconds. This bounded legacy Voyage slice can run before the general matrix navigator; integrate with bd-01M35A7D5DH1AB8XYWH00DFFHE later.

Reuse the existing Voyage document/compiler/lowering/view; no new frontend or view-side scientific inference. Preserve semantic identities, supplied values, origin shapes, external-dominant hollows, group-level support and existing inspector exact text. Do not add native media boundaries or evidence links without checked producer capabilities. Record exact revision/artifact tuple and run affected Scala gates plus real-browser and synthetic failure witnesses. Existing frozen Sherlock artifacts are regression inputs, not scientific validation. Rollback: disable the new display/control and retain the existing checked Voyage route; never rewrite original artifacts. An actual Intaglio deficiency belongs in ~/code/scala/intaglio with its own Mote ticket and producer-consumer witness. No renderer defect is established by this ticket.
set.title: [Voyage] Make the recall overview brush drive a readable detail viewport
